savings.reason: Full EO:13385 actor context read: §§3/9 revoke the relevant orders without any express saving of their commands; other continuation and amendment provisions concern named other committees. Preexisting statutory/agency authorities and accrued consequences are not continuing independent duties created by these orders. This finding concerns residual operation after formal revocation and does not decide the missing earlier first-end chronology.

research_rationale: Full original, own terms, actor contexts, chain, searches and missing list read. EO:13328 §8 expressly governs Commission termination, while §2(d) reporting date is a deadline. Actual report submission and exact termination are absent; within 60 days does not itself state an exact termination day. §2(d) also contains independent agency-use and presidential consultation/proposal commands; these were split in the corrected exact-span inventory and are not treated as extinguished merely by Commission termination. §5(b) security obligations concern the work and protected information; §§6(c)-(d) preserve preexisting authorities without themselves transferring the Commission. EO:13385 §3(a), ACT:EO:13328>EO:13385 chars 3778-4063, formally revokes this order effective 2005-09-30 under §10 effective#0 chars 9663-9712. That reaches any then-remaining independent command but does not establish its earliest cessation. No source has been fetched and the supplied bounded searches are not used to invent the absent factual trigger. Local draft only, pending full GitHub freeze; unable to accept for review on current dossier.
unresolved_material_gaps: ORIGINAL:EO:13328 §8, chars 10829-10925, terminates the Commission within 60 days after actual report submission. The dossier lacks submission/transmission and exact termination evidence; §2(d) March 31, 2005 reporting deadline (chars 4454-5260) cannot substitute for the actual trigger or establish an exact earlier end.

ORIGINAL:EO:13328 §2(d) separately directs Intelligence Community use of the resulting report (chars 5261-5401) and presidential consultation/proposals within 90 days after receipt (chars 5402-5670). Commission termination alone does not establish first ends for these independent commands; actual receipt/completion or other cessation evidence is absent.
